chunks.snippet: Employees may work from home up to three days per week with manager approval and must be in the office on designated collaboration days.
Remote work requests longer than two weeks require an updated schedule in the HR portal and confirmation from the manager.
VPN access is granted automatically for employees in engineering and support after multi-factor enrollment is verified.
If VPN access fails, confirm device compliance and request a password reset before escalating to IT.
Password resets are self-service for verified users. The reset link expires after 30 minutes.
MFA re-enrollment requires identity verification and is handled through the IT portal.
